mode.mapStudio: Map Studio · Left-click to paint, right-drag to move the map, scroll to zoom

startScreensHint: Open the scenario and country selection to switch scenario or country; shortcut F2
unsupportedControl: "{control}" is not available in Game View yet.
mapStudioHint: Paint your own world right on the world map: terrain and countries, then build it and save it as a new world.
mapStudioSavedBody: {states} states. The map is now the world you painted.
uiEditHint: Edit interface images and text. Clicking selects an element instead of activating its button.
textEditHint: Edit decisions, characters, focuses, and other content. Buttons keep working; click a map province to edit its terrain, state, and name.

inspect.viewHint: View mode: click a technology to inspect it. Enter Content Edit to change or save it.

continuousPanelMove: Drag to move the continuous focus panel out of the way (only in this window, not the mod); double-click to put it back
continuousPanelPlace: Drag to set where the mod places the continuous focus panel
